about: What the What's new window lists for each program version (docs/whats-new.md). Newest first; the first entry is this build's version. Wording reviewed with GPT Astra 6.2 on 2026-11-28.

items.title: You can now import slides without PowerPoint
items.detail: If needed, it asks to download LibreOffice (about 375 MB).

items.title: Imported slides now build up click by click
items.detail: Effects are simpler. Videos, sounds and animated GIFs play.

items.title: Songs you add or edit go to the library
items.detail: Your version stays on this laptop until it's in the library.

items.title: Program updates no longer ask you to restart
items.detail: The new version opens the next time CGF Projector starts.

items.title: New photos load the right way up
items.detail: Rotate any picture in the Pictures tab or slide show editor.

items.title: Bibles now update automatically
items.detail: Updates wait while a passage is selected for projection, even if hidden.

items.title: Local tools for managing Bibles and songbooks
items.detail: The CGF library supplies both. You can still add songs.
